The '''Ethrani system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Valahari sector/Legends|Valahari sector]], a part of the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]].<ref name="New Territories" /> It was home to a [[Species/Legends|creature]] known as the [[Ethrani ourobouros]].<ref name="ROTS" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ethrani system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square N-5.<ref name="EAOC" />
